description_en: Retrieves a custom image preparation task by using a submitted client token and queries the current progress
description_zh: 使用已提交的 clientToken 找回自定义镜像准备任务并查询当前进度
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore find-custom-agent-image-preparation --workspace-id ws-example --client-token image-update-20261022-001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FindCustomAgentImagePreparation

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token passed as a query parameter. Required when explicitly submitting customImage or container.type=custom. Optional for ACR image and code package submissions. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods, underscores, colons, and hyphens. Reuse the same token for retries of the same submission. Using the same token for different parameters is rejected
parameters.help_zh: 通过 Query 参数传入的幂等标识。显式提交 customImage 或 container.type=custom 时必填；ACR 镜像与代码包提交可选。长度为 1～128 个字符，允许字母、数字、点、下划线、冒号和连字符；同一提交重试复用，相同标识用于不同参数会被拒绝
parameters.name: client_token

data.description_en: The preparation query result. Check the phase for the asynchronous execution status
data.description_zh: 准备查询结果；异步执行状态看 phase

agentId.description_en: The ID of the target agent

error.description_en: The error information. Returned only when the preparation fails. Otherwise, the value is null
error.description_zh: 仅失败返回安全错误，其余为 null

code.description_en: The business error code for image preparation. Used to identify the failure type. For the specific cause, see the message
code.description_zh: 镜像准备的业务错误码；用于识别失败类型，具体原因见 message
code.title_en: 镜像准备的业务错误码；用于识别失败类型，具体原因见 message
code.title_zh: 镜像准备的业务错误码；用于识别失败类型，具体原因见 message

message.description_en: The specific cause of the failure. It may include underlying errors such as image not found, authentication failure, network timeout, or certificate verification error. Passwords, tokens, or authentication headers are not returned. A general description is returned if the underlying cause is not provided
message.description_zh: 本次失败的具体原因，可包含底层返回的镜像不存在、认证失败、网络超时或证书校验错误；不返回密码、令牌或认证头。底层未提供原因时返回通用说明
message.example: tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
